name: agenthub
description: Interface multi-agents — des employés IA organisés en pôles, qui se délèguent des tâches et travaillent en salons temps réel.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check db.js && node --check llm.js && node --check orchestrator.js && node --check public/app.js
scripts.test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/boot-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/integration-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/password-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/search-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/i18n-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/archive-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/preview-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" agenthub:latest node /test/mcp-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" -e REPO_DIR=/repo agenthub:latest node /test/readme-test.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/test:ro" -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" -e REPO_DIR=/repo agenthub:latest node /test/style-test.mjs
